description: A series of mysterious thefts have left the coastal town of Nice in turmoil. As the sun sets, shadows dance along the promenade, and whispers of a notorious thief echo through the streets. Your mission is to uncover the identity of the elusive suspect before they vanish into the night. Follow the clues hidden in the dialogue of locals and the artifacts left behind, but beware of the misleading tales that may lead you astray.
